and social media channels. All times are shown in U.S. Eastern. U.S. Eastern corresponds to UTC‑4 until 2 a.m. EDT on November 1, 2026, and to UTC‑5 thereafter. Quick Facts NASA+, the agency’s ad-free, on-demand streaming service, requires no subscription. 1 Upcoming Events Thursday, April 16 2:30 p.m. | News conference with the Artemis II crew: NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, and Christina Koch, and CSA (Canadian Space Agency) astronaut Jeremy Hansen. Stream on YouTube Tuesday, April 21 4 p.m. | News conference on NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope with agency leadership.
